【Professional Design】Saker caulk tool kit of upgraded tools combine 5 functions into 1, including internal angle scraper, flat angle scraper, silicone smoother, glass cement opener and nozzle needle. It can help you remove the seal and re-sealing.

【Durable Material】 Saker caulking tool kit have sharp hard stainless steel blade for long-lasting strength removing; Nice Silicone Trowel for the removal of bumps and dents surface; White silicone pads for smooth application of new silicone!

【Effectiveness】Saker grout removal tool with versatile tools with many uses, easy to rip the old caulk and smooth the caulk well. No need for masking tape, it is convenient and quick to use and save time.

【Multiple Usage Scenarios】Saker caulk removal tool kit is good ideal for home, kitchen, bathroom, tank, window, sink, joint and so on. The smart dimension is applicable for interior and exterior caulking.
